# SortController

> Manages column sort state and dispatches `ui-sort` events.

## Constructor

```ts
new SortController(host: HTMLElement, options?: SortOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-sort` | `{ column, direction }` |

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `destroy()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { SortController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new SortController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
